corporateTransportation.faq.oneOffAnswer: Yes. Corporate Transportation supports one-off requests for a defined business schedule.
corporateTransportation.faq.recurringAns: Yes. Recurring corporate arrangements are supported when the company needs transportation across several journeys or a longer period.
corporateTransportation.faq.commercialAn: Business-client invoicing and negotiated commercial terms are supported when they are confirmed for the specific corporate arrangement.
corporateTransportation.faq.dedicatedAns: Yes. The same chauffeur can remain across connected schedule points when this is part of the confirmed corporate service.
corporateTransportation.faq.outsideAreaA: Requests outside the standard Belgrade service area are reviewed individually through a quote.
corporateTransportation.faq.vehicleAnswe: Yes. State the preferred vehicle in the request. The specific model is checked and confirmed as part of the booking.
corporateTransportation.faq.confirmation: No. The team checks availability, vehicle and schedule details, then confirms the booking manually.
